blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Months after a devastating magnitude 7.8 earthquake fractured communities in southern Mindanao, military forces remain entrenched in the region not for combat, but to rebuild — completing 89 temporary shelters for displaced families in Sarangani province. Maj. Gen. Alvin Luzon, commander of the Army’s 10th Infantry Division, led an ocular and aerial inspection on Thursday, Sept. 24, to assess the ongoing rehabilitation of disaster-hit towns in Glan, Sarangani, and Jose Abad Santos, Davao Occidental.
